narr: An unstable atmosphere was in place on the afternoon of July 7th ahead of a cold frontal passage. Scattered thunderstorms crossed through the state during the heat of the afternoon and resulted in strong wind gusts that blew down several trees in the region. A 47 mph wind gust was observed at the Huntington airport around the time downed trees were noted around the area. The combination of rising moisture levels and slow moving and repetitive storms also resulted in localized water issues in Fayette and Randolph Counties.
ev: South of the town of Oak Hill, Route 61 was briefly inundated with high water.
High water occurred along Main Street and the adjacent roadways in the town of Harman for a short time due to overflowing culverts.
